note: Machine-checkable registry of deferred work items and carried-over acceptance criteria. Discipline is isomorphic to .ship-gate/skip-ledger.json (schema @3) and the ADR-0020 conformance expected-failures ledger: every deferral is an explicit, traceable record, never a silent drop. ADR-0057 D5 / D-006 requires one entry per carried-over acceptance criterion, marked closed-by the ADR that closes it. Old ADR bodies are never edited; the pointer line lives in the old ADR and the record lives here (Nygard / AWS / MS / MADR / KEP / GEP bidirectional-pointer convention, atomic same PR). Additive only: new entries are appended, existing ids are never reused or renumbered.
